prompt:
Tech House (Underground Style), 128 BPM, Key of Eb Minor,,
Style Category: Underground Tech House,,
Kick: Tight Punchy Tech House Kick with Clean Click transient,,
Bass: Deep Driving Monophonic Sub Bass with Tube Warmth,,
Percussion: Tight Closed Hats, Claps on 2 and 4, and Woodblock Drops,,
Dynamics: Sidechain Ducking 90%, Stereo Width 85%, Dynamic Range 9.2dB,,
Mastering: Club Ready, -11.0 LUFS Target, Punchy Peak Limiting

how_to_improve_further: Espandere i campioni di percussioni con transienti in legno organico e rimshot micro-pitchati.
